prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent 2.5D infantry formation sprite for a Japanese grand-strategy map.
Input images: Image 1 is the ORIGINAL east-facing infantry formation, a character/material/scale reference ONLY. Image 2 is an ORIGINAL castle miniature, painted material reference only. Create a NEW west-facing view of the same generic infantry, do not rotate or mirror either bitmap. Do not draw a castle.
Primary request: one compact formation of generic Japanese spear infantry marching SCREEN LEFT (west). Every soldier's body and head clearly faces left; show left-facing profiles. Staggered ranks create miniature depth, with all complete feet visible.
Style/medium: same believable finely hand-painted miniature soldiers as Image 1, muted charcoal and blue-grey lamellar armor, simple iron helmets with neck guards, olive-grey clothing, small natural skin tones and worn wood spear shafts. Refined tiny military formation, not flat vector, chibi, toy or low-poly. Generic original fictional troops, no exact historic clan identity or named heroes.
Composition: one centered compact unit on a square genuinely transparent canvas, same high oblique overhead camera around 55 degrees. Compact staggered formation, feet form a shallow oval near lower middle; short controlled gaps between soldiers. Spears mostly upright and entirely visible. Entire group has transparent margins. Cohesive readable broad masses that remain legible at a small map scale.
Lighting: fixed soft NORTHWEST light from image upper left, darker lower-right material planes, tiny contact shadows beneath feet. Repaint the view with this fixed lighting; do not rotate lighting with marching direction.
Constraints: infantry only, no horses, guns, flags, banners, poles without spearheads, insignia, text, UI, numbers, watermark, castle, ground tile, baseplate, landscape, sky or background. No large shadow blob. Exactly one west-facing formation, not a sheet or multiple views. Compact square sprite below 2048 pixels per side.
